cohort: The study included 354 mothers from the GDM Mother and Child Study (GMCS) at Wuxi People's Hospital, Nanjing Medical University.
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) significantly elevates the risk of premature rupture of membranes (PROM) through metabolic alterations, and elevated hydroxydesmethylpiperine sulfate levels are identified as a potential PROM risk biomarker in GDM-PROM cases.
